sources.title: DONKI solar flare event 2024-05-10T06:27:00-FLR-001, version 2
sources.organization: NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center, DONKI
sources.transformation: Used as historical context for discussing solar alerts and preparation, not as live data.

sources.title: NASA Achieves Water Recovery Milestone on International Space Station
sources.unit: percent of water recovery in the reported ISS system
sources.transformation: Illustrates why recycling matters for life support; the fictional base uses a separate, explicitly designed budget.
sources.limitations: ISS system performance is not a direct model of the game's base or its water and oxygen expenditures.

sources.title: Veggie plant growth system activated on International Space Station
sources.transformation: Shows that growing food takes time; the game uses a simplified milestone and local-only outcome.
sources.limitations: The 28-day observation is not a growth rate, yield, resource requirement, or promise for the fictional game.

sources.title: How NASA Will Protect Astronauts From Space Radiation at the Moon

observations.topic: Radiation protection and space weather on lunar missions

sources.transformation: Provides context for preparing shelter and responding to space weather.
sources.limitations: The game does not calculate dose, shielding thickness, probability of survival, or an actual NASA operating cost.

sources.title: How Does Webb See Back in Time?
sources.unit: seconds, approximate one-way light travel time
sources.transformation: An approximately 2.6-second round trip is shown as a simple educational communication delay, with no extra resource charge.
sources.limitations: Distance varies and real communication delays include processing and network effects; the game is not a communications simulator.
